'''Operation Force Crush''' was a covert operation undertaken in the [[Great Galactic War]] by a [[Pierce's black ops team|team]] of black ops soldiers from the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] under the leadership of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]].
